name: manifest-dev-tools
description: Tools for prompts and PRs alongside the manifest workflow. Includes collaborative PR walkthroughs, autonomous PR review that independently re-verifies a manifest gate by gate, author-side PR babysitting that drives the lifecycle toward green and mergeable, gap-calibrated prompt engineering, standalone goals distilled from Manifests, cross-boundary context handoff, incremental teaching, and an eli5 explainer that renders any topic as big pictures and few words.
